item.title: 【Helpdesk】Im gonna end my life in 5 minutes
item.description:
I am not very good at writing what I feel, in fact I never had the freedom to express my feelings during my life. I love you very much mom and I'm sorry for everything. "Why are you going to kill yourself?" I am 22 years old, when I was a kid my dad used to beat my mom and then raped me. My childhood was a nightmare, because of the traumas I never had a chance to have any friends, laugh at any jokes or go on any school trips. The only thing that makes me want to go on living is when I feel my mom's hugs. My mom is the purest and strongest person I have ever met, I am just weak and a loser. She did everything she could for me to study, she borrowed money from the bank and even washed strangers' clothes. Unfortunately for not getting a company to do my internship for school credit I have failed a course. My graduation is this Sunday and I'm screwed. It's 200 fucking dollars and this is bullshit.

I have attended state therapy and the therapist told me that if I felt like committing suicide I should do it. It is sad and I feel bad for having invested so much in psychologists and not getting any positive results in my life.

I never had a chance to talk about my favorite things and it's kind of sad to have to do it now.

My favorite band is The Strokes

My favorite movie is Casino (1995)

My favorite video game is Super Mario Bros.
